comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: Does anyone have a full list of where all these can be built or purchased?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Can be bought at, in no particular order:

Northern Europe: Amsterdam, Antwerp, Kokkola, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Danzig, Nantes, Hamburg, Groningen, Bremen, Plymouth, Bergen, Bordeaux, Lubeck, London
Western Europe: Porto, Ceuta, Seville, Barcelona, Valencia, Lisbon
US East Coast: Boston*
West coast of North America: San Francisco

Boston won't be in GAMA until Chapter of 1 the future expansion, Age of Revolution. Not sure if you can also build them at those places as well, having zero clue how shipbuilding works.
